symptom: Linking the full PH01-PH16 materiality contract into mandatory chat-learning preflight caused the fixed 256000-byte compiler budget to fail (observed 259322 bytes; minification still yielded 257740 bytes).
rootCause: Canonical durable truth and hot-path preflight projection were treated as the same payload. Full detailed contracts duplicated decision-irrelevant detail into every agent preflight.
failedApproaches: Increase maxBytes merely to make the new source fit.
Minify the full contract while still loading every field in every preflight.
fix: Keep the full canonical contract in config and expose only a bounded decision projection containing fingerprint, blocker state, prevention rule and canonical contract pointer.
preventionRules: Keep the preflight byte budget fail-closed; do not silently raise it when learning grows.
Separate full canonical truth from bounded hot-path preflight projection.
Every compact projection must point to the canonical detail source.
Adding durable learning must not make every agent materially more expensive when a pointer is sufficient.
evidence: Brain foundation failed with maxBytes exceeded: 259322 > 256000 when the full contract was linked.
After contract minification it still failed at 257740 > 256000, proving minification alone was insufficient.
